content_value: Between Biaxial and Uniaxial Geogrid and Cellular Confinement Technologies, Geosynthetics Have Been at the Forefront of Soil Stabilization Applications Since 1959.
BUILT FOR CONTRACTORS , TRUSTED BY ENGINEERS
Value Engineering, Cross-Section Reductions, and Material Cost Savings.

BaseLok<sup>®</sup> delivers value-engineered geosynthetic solutions for heavy-haul roads, crane pads, industrial laydown yards, and paved roadways. Our geogrid stabilization systems reinforce weak, low-CBR subgrades, improve aggregate confinement, and optimize base thickness to help site contractors reduce construction costs, accelerate project schedules, and lower overall infrastructure costs per square yard.
